format: assembly language (AGC - Apollo Guidance Computer assembly language)
description: This file contains the source code for the interpretive instruction engine of the Luminary project, implemented in AGC assembly language. It includes routines for interpreting, dispatching, and executing interpretive programs, managing memory addressing modes, and interfacing with the Executive for job scheduling and context switching. The file also references constant definitions and external subroutines that support interpretive logic and inter-bank communication.

methods.name: INTPRET
methods.description: Main entry point for the interpretive instruction engine; sets up initial execution context and begins interpretation cycle.

methods.name: INTRSM
methods.description: Resumes an interpretive job after suspension, used when the Executive switches context.

methods.name: DANZIG
methods.description: Main interpretive loop; handles job switching, opcode dispatch, and advancing interpretive instructions.

methods.name: NEWOPS
methods.description: Fetches the next opcode pair for interpretation from memory.

methods.name: ADDRESS
methods.description: Decodes memory addresses considering various addressing modes and memory banks.

methods.name: DIRADRES
methods.description: Calculates direct addresses in memory, accounting for relative and fixed memory schemes.

methods.name: INDEX
methods.description: Handles indexed addressing mode, applying index registers to addresses.

methods.name: PUSHUP
methods.description: Retrieves operands from the interpretive pushdown list or stack when explicit addresses are missing.

methods.name: STORJUMP
methods.description: Performs store operations and facilitates branch transfers in interpretive programs.

methods.name: DOSTORE
methods.description: Executes store codes, handling data movement to memory or to other interpretive routines.

methods.name: CALL
methods.description: Subroutine call within interpretive programs, setting up return pointers and jumping to called code.

methods.name: RTB
methods.description: Return from interpretive subroutines to the calling context.
